name: system-first-project-second
prompt: Integrate the kernel into a fast-moving startup that has no system context and scattered project docs.
must: inventory existing instructions skills tools and project evidence before editing
create or reconcile a thin system layer before compiling project context
keep each newly created system file to 1-10 steering lines excluding its title
then create or refresh PROJECT.md and fast-changing project state
preserve a clear current wedge and larger structural trajectory
must_not: create one file per conventional department
put current project facts into system context

name: existing-rich-environment
prompt: The user already has strong global instructions, 20 global skills, project-local skills, and several MCP tools.
must: treat global content as read-only without explicit authority
inspect skill descriptions and actual boundaries rather than names alone
identify underused existing capability before proposing new skills
distinguish active host tools from configuration files merely present on disk
leave a concrete transformation report
must_not: silently delete or rewrite user-level skills
install duplicate company-kernel variants of capabilities that already exist

name: multiple-capabilities-same-domain
prompt: A startup needs account discovery, trigger sensing, live demo generation, and enterprise procurement support.
must: allow several distinct GTM capabilities when their triggers and outputs differ
avoid forcing one generic GTM skill
build only repeated gaps not already handled by the model tools or installed skills
must_not: enforce one skill per business function
merge capabilities merely because they all relate to GTM

name: access-not-skill
prompt: Agents repeatedly make bad product decisions because they cannot access product analytics or support history.
must: identify missing evidence access as the primary gap
avoid solving the problem with another strategy or product skill
state the tool connector or evidence surface that would change decisions
must_not: pretend instructions can replace unavailable data

name: skill-creation-earned
prompt: The project repeatedly converts public trigger events into account-specific demos and no current skill owns the workflow.
must: verify the job is repeated and current capabilities are insufficient
create a project-local skill with clear positive and negative triggers
put deterministic collection or formatting in scripts where useful
include trigger and behavior cases before recommending promotion to user scope
must_not: create a global skill by default
copy the entire system worldview into the new skill

name: coherence-finding
prompt: Homepage sells an autonomous operator, onboarding configures a toolkit, and the app opens on an analytics dashboard.
must: surface the conflicting product models
preserve one customer-facing product truth across system and project context
distinguish product coherence from implementation completeness
identify which surfaces expose internal machinery
must_not: treat the conflict as a copywriting problem only

name: non-startup-project
prompt: Integrate the environment for an open-source protocol project with contributor and ecosystem goals.
must: adapt system lenses to adoption maintainability and technical leverage
avoid forcing buyer pipeline and venture-scale language
still pursue the largest coherent consequence supported by the project
must_not: create startup GTM files for symmetry
